modes.subtitle: Impact Dummy Derby
modes.authority_contract: game-core 10s damage + Kinetic Bat final launch
modes.first_play_instructions: Land hits on the Impact Dummy for 10 seconds. Build damage, trigger the Kinetic Bat launch, and chase distance. Ordinary attack input owns the result — scripted sims never earn REAL_PLAYER.
modes.win_condition: Complete the 10s damage contract and record bat-launch distance without leaving the Trial.
modes.loss_condition: Timer expires with no player-owned hits, or journey aborted before RESULTS.
modes.retry_policy: Retry returns to SETUP with a fresh seed snapshot; prior SIMULATION records stay local-only.

modes.subtitle: Flagline Clash
modes.authority_contract: five-room push-pull -2..+2; solar/lunar internal; Beaconward/Veilward display
modes.first_play_instructions: 2v2 Flagline: occupy the core, contest capture, and push rooms from -2 to +2. CPU fills empty seats — seats are not simultaneous humans. Win by room control, not HUD-only scoreboard.
modes.win_condition: Push the Flagline to a terminal room win (solarWinsGame / lunarWinsGame) with actual combat bodies.
modes.loss_condition: Opposing team reaches terminal room, or journey exits before gameWon.
modes.retry_policy: Retry resets room 0 and actor stocks; four-body honesty preserved.

modes.subtitle: Paint the Floor
modes.authority_contract: 60s territorial; harmonic tiles; a11y beyond color
modes.first_play_instructions: Move to paint harmonic tiles for 60 seconds. Attacks claim contested cells. Markers are not color-only. Live shared combat ticks paint from real positions.
modes.win_condition: Hold the plurality of painted tiles when the 60s phase resolves to RESULTS.
modes.loss_condition: Opponent plurality at RESULTS, or abort before paint authority resolves.
modes.retry_policy: Retry clears the weave grid and reseeds; prior paint is not career progress.

player_counts.honest_note: ten-fighter roster cap; current playable seats 2–4 until PartyLink depth

modes.subtitle: 4-Lane Blaster
modes.authority_contract: 4 lanes, 3 lives, seeded waves; Fracture Echoes lore
modes.first_play_instructions: Defend four lanes across seeded waves. Attack fires the active lane; Fracture Echo enemies are Trials-only. Three lives — ordinary input owns echo hits.
modes.win_condition: Clear the seeded wave set without exhausting lives.
modes.loss_condition: Lives reach zero, or journey abort mid-wave.
modes.retry_policy: Retry restores three lives and reseeds waves; echo actors stay Trials-scoped.

modes.subtitle: Survival Gauntlet
modes.authority_contract: Echoes not real Puppets/souls; bosses as simulations; no canonical cosmic defeat
modes.first_play_instructions: Survive the Echo gauntlet. Bosses are simulations — never real Puppets/souls. Ordinary attacks drive the sim. Cosmic manifestations cannot deliver a canonical defeat.
modes.win_condition: Clear the gauntlet score gate without a canonical cosmic defeat flag.
modes.loss_condition: Gauntlet fail state without cosmic canon, or abort before RESULTS.
modes.retry_policy: Retry restarts wave 0; cosmic defeat remains non-canonical.

modes.subtitle: UNBALANCED MYTHIC
modes.authority_contract: full supers, min cooldowns, instant resources, extended transforms, rapid respawn, amplified knockback; never ranked MMR
modes.first_play_instructions: Mythic Unbound combat: supers, short cooldowns, instant resources, colossus/prismatic/puppet Trials-only actors. Avatar KO is not true defeat. Never feeds ranked MMR. Everlasting Origin needs mythic consent.
modes.win_condition: Resolve the Unbound preset journey to RESULTS without ranked contamination.
modes.loss_condition: Session abort, or mythic consent denied when Everlasting is required.
modes.retry_policy: Retry rebuilds the Unbound session; Versus/Story modifiers stay cleared on exit.

player_counts.honest_note: PartyLink honest seat counts; live max 4 until PartyLink depth; colossus seats opt-in Mythic only
